segments.title: That bright 'star' before sunrise?
segments.say: That bright star before sunrise. What is it? Sirius, Venus, or a satellite? Three. Two. One.

segments.title: It's the planet VENUS!
segments.say: It's Venus! A planet, not a star.

segments.title: Brighter than ANY star
segments.say: It outshines every star. That's why it's called the morning star.

segments.title: This morning: a triangle
segments.say: This morning, Venus, the Moon and the star Spica made a triangle.

segments.title: Look east before sunrise
segments.say: Look east before dawn. It stays bright all December.
Follow for Guess It number 38 tonight.
